arms.description: Donor-complete diagnosis, evidence gating, admissible recovery, dependency/protection, mutation authorization and execution enforcement. Selects the highest validated or predicted task-restoration utility among admissible revisions without a dedicated strictly-narrower-exhaustion rule or incomparable-minima discriminator.
Admits a high-level revision when it restores the target and passes generic protected safety. It omits the requirement that strictly narrower admissible revisions first be demonstrated insufficient.

Receives exactly the P1-X responsibility classes, invasiveness relation, counterfactual outcomes, preservation predicates, reopen map and authority predicates. If these semantics are identical, it is expected to reproduce the P1-X decision function extensionally.

Retains evidence-admissible revision candidates; removes broader candidates when a registered strictly narrower admissible revision is demonstrated sufficient; returns discriminator/UNRESOLVED for incomparable minima; and requires restoration, invariant preservation, exact reopen-scope fidelity and external authority before high-level execution certification.
